parameters.name: AudioFormat
parameters.description: The audio format. Only **wav** and **mp3** formats are supported.

parameters.name: BizCode
parameters.description:
The speech model identifier, which is user-defined. It supports letters and digits, with a length of 1 to 32 characters, and must be unique within the project.

Set the identifier to the initials of the speech model semantics in pinyin. For example, set `支付到账` (payment received) to `ZFDZ`.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: SharePromotionActivityId
parameters.description:
The promotional activity ID.

This is the **Data** value returned by the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** operation.

parameters.name: ShareTaskCode
parameters.description:
The share code of the sharing task.

For information about the share code, see [Use shared devices to play shared speech models](~~607661~~).

parameters.name: SpeechModelType
parameters.description: The speech model type. Only the fixed value **custom** is supported, which indicates a custom speech model.

parameters.name: SpeechRate
parameters.description: The playback speed. Valid values: -500 to 500.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The speech model text. It supports letters, Chinese characters, and spaces, with a length of 1 to 100 characters. A Chinese character occupies two characters.

parameters.name: Voice
parameters.description: The voice for speech model playback, which is preset by the system, such as standard female voice or standard male voice. You can call the [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) operation to query available voice types. Set this parameter to the **Value** in **VoiceList** from the response.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100.
